newsitem.title: USA: US spot LPG activity quiet amid industry events.
newsitem.headline: US spot LPG activity quiet amid industry events.

text.p: U.S. spot liquefied petroleum gas prices were steady in very quiet trade on Monday due to several industry seminars and outings, players said.
There were at least three golf tournaments and seminars on Monday for the LPG market and few players were in their offices.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane was talked steady at 33.75/34.00 cents a gallon. Conway, Kansas, was too thin to peg.
Meanwhile, an explosion at Shell Oil Co's chemical plant in Houston had little impact on the market. The blast occurred on Sunday in the olefin unit where ethylene and propylene are produced.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
